replies.author: keritans
replies.text: Year-old config archaeology 😂 Old commits or saved chats might give you a rough timeline. Even “here’s what survived and what I ditched” would be useful — doesn’t need a perfect origin story.

replies.author: _yaralexie
replies.text: For us, it’s explaining the same product in fresh ways without every post becoming a pitch 😅 Keeping useful replies going alongside building is the other bit. A way to turn real questions into draft ideas, keep our voice, and review before posting would help.

replies.author: matrix_doctor
replies.text: The “done ✅” message is doing a lot of heavy lifting sometimes 😅 I’d want the agent to show the checks it ran and what it couldn’t verify. CI + a look at the actual diff makes that much easier to judge.
